06-24-1335 is June 24, 1335.  
34 weeks = 238 days.  
Add 6 days → total 244 days.  
June 24 + 244 days: June has 6 days left (30-24), July 31, Aug 31, Sep 30, Oct 31, Nov 30, Dec 31, Jan 31 → sum: 6+31+31+30+31+30+31=190 days (end at Jan 31, 1336). Remaining 244-190=54 days into 1336.  
Feb 1336 is leap year? 1336 divisible by 4 → yes, 29 days in Feb. 54-29=25 days left → March 25, 1336.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1336-03-25
